claim.scope_statement: For primes p,q, q² divides 2^p−1 iff q is an odd base-2 Wieferich prime with ord_q(2)=p. Exact enumeration excludes every q≤100000 as a repeated factor for every prime exponent p, without an exponent cutoff. No universal square-freeness conclusion is drawn.
